recognize_zh: 組織被小至中型、核輪廓不規則的淋巴球瀰漫取代，其間散布較大、核空泡狀有核仁的細胞，並有組織球與小血管；細胞大小呈連續譜系而非雙相，是 PTCL, NOS 較常見的表現。
features: Diffuse infiltrate dominated by small-to-medium lymphocytes
Irregular, angulated nuclear contours in many small cells
Scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Admixed epithelioid histiocytes and small vessels with plump endothelium
No follicles, granulomas or Reed-Sternberg-like cells in this field
describe_en: Section shows diffuse effacement by a lymphoid infiltrate composed predominantly of small-to-medium lymphocytes with irregular nuclear contours, admixed with scattered larger cells showing vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli. Epithelioid histiocytes and small vessels with plump endothelial cells are interspersed. No follicles, granulomas or classic Reed-Sternberg cells are identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified; immunohistochemistry to confirm an aberrant T-cell phenotype and exclude TFH-derived lymphoma, along with TCR clonality testing, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia preserves nodal architecture with a polymorphous population of immunoblasts and plasma cells, without aberrant T-cell antigen loss or clonal TCR.
The Lennert variant shows numerous clustered epithelioid histiocytes with small CD8+ T cells, a pattern only partly suggested here.
AITL has prominent arborizing HEVs, perivascular clear cells and expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks with PD1/CXCL13 expression.
